newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nanshan '96 net reaches 71 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Nanshan '96 net reaches 71 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Nanshan Power Station Co Ltd racked up net profits of 71.11 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
Earnings per share were 0.359 yuan and turnover reached 428.07 million yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not reveal whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 50.98 million yuan under international standards.
The company's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.3 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the firm's A and B shares will be suspended on Monday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
